name: PandaSet
summary: 面向自动驾驶研究的多传感器数据集，提供相机、激光雷达、GPS/IMU 和三维标注，覆盖城市道路中的车辆、行人和交通场景。
summaryEn: A multi-sensor autonomous-driving dataset with cameras, LiDAR, GPS/IMU, and 3D annotations across urban traffic scenes.
scaleZh: 48,000+ 帧激光雷达扫描 · 6,000+ 段相机序列 · 28 个场景
license: PandaSet License; commercial and attribution terms apply
licenseZh: 适用 PandaSet 许可；包含商业使用和署名条款
verdict: 多传感器自动驾驶数据
wmNote: 传感器同步和三维标注适合时空场景建模，但缺少直接的车辆控制动作。
wmNoteEn: Synchronized sensors and 3D labels support spatiotemporal scene modeling, although direct vehicle controls are not provided.

evidence.statement: Official devkit exposes sequences of sensor measurements and per-frame poses; retain sequential recordings.
